acceptance_contract.rule: APP-10 requires executable evidence that BASE exposes everything needed for the frozen FRANK architecture without semantic escape hatches; it does not nominate frank_runtime.clay as the mandatory production source file.

still_unclassified_for_root_contract_exe: rich union/generic/record type declarations in one mixed source unit
lambda/map sugar such as x => x.id
named-argument or constructor sugar where present

decision.reason: The source self-identifies as a semantic runtime contract and the current receipt-gated APP-10/FULL_FRANK production chain selects other executable frozen FRANK programs. Existing generic structured ClayCode already realizes the main procedural constructs. Missing root-contract sugar therefore does not justify BASE semantic widening or block the current release unless this exact source becomes a selected executable acceptance input.
decision.reactivation_rule: If frank_runtime.clay or a byte-identical descendant is explicitly selected as a WP13/APP10 production executable, unresolved constructs immediately become gate-relevant and must be solved by the smallest typed/versioned dialect or lowering path before PASS.
